Market today: AI momentum is strong for software, with Salesforce and Okta surging. However, the chip sector faces new competitive threats from custom AI chips, creating a mixed picture for your tech-heavy book.

Your holdings: SOXL (-54.18%) and SPAL (-40.36%) are leveraged, deeply in the red, and need immediate attention. Margin amplifies these drops. SMH (-12.67%) also needs trimming.

Watch: Monitor continued AI software strength and the potential impact of custom chip competition on your semiconductor holdings.

Bottom line: Prioritize managing your leveraged, losing positions and stay vigilant on chip sector competition.
plays: Set a tight, active stop for SOXL (current price 116.6) to prevent further decay on this leveraged position.
Set a tight, active stop for SPAL (current price 15) to limit downside on this new, leveraged holding.
Trim SMH as indicated by your scanner, especially with new competitive pressures emerging in the chip sector.
